name: Bodh Gaya
description: Famous for Mahabodhi Temple and the place associated with Buddha's enlightenment.

name: Nalanda
description: Explore the ancient Nalanda Mahavihara and its archaeological remains.

name: Rajgir
description: Explore scenic hills, historical attractions and the famous Glass Bridge area.

image.alt: Rugged hills and landscape around Rajgir

name: Vaishali
description: Discover ancient heritage sites and the Ashokan Pillar.

image.alt: Ananda Stupa and Ashokan pillar at Vaishali

name: Patna
description: Explore Bihar Museum, Golghar and the historic city of Patna.

name: Vikramshila
description: Visit the archaeological remains of the ancient Vikramshila Mahavihara.

name: Kolkata
description: Discover a vibrant cultural capital of grand architecture, riverside landmarks, sacred temples and celebrated food.

areas: Eco Park and Science City in New Town

attractions.name: Victoria Memorial
attractions.description: Explore the white-marble landmark, its gardens and museum galleries on the Maidan.

attractions.name: Howrah Bridge
attractions.description: See the landmark cantilever bridge spanning the Hooghly River; the riverfront offers memorable views.

attractions.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
attractions.description: Visit the riverside temple complex known for its shrine to Goddess Kali and distinctive architecture.

attractions.name: Kalighat Temple
attractions.description: Experience one of Kolkata's most revered Hindu pilgrimage sites in the south of the city.

attractions.name: Indian Museum
attractions.description: Browse extensive collections covering archaeology, art, geology and natural history.

attractions.name: Prinsep Ghat
attractions.description: Enjoy a riverside walk beside the Hooghly and the landmark Palladian-style memorial.

attractions.name: Eco Park
attractions.description: Spend time among gardens, lakes and recreational spaces in New Town.

attractions.name: Science City
attractions.description: Explore interactive science exhibits and attractions suited to curious visitors of all ages.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February is generally cooler and comfortable for sightseeing. Durga Puja, usually in September or October, is a spectacular but very busy time to visit.
travelTips: Use the Metro for cross-city journeys and check current service times and station access before setting out.
Group Victoria Memorial, Indian Museum and Prinsep Ghat together; allow extra time for traffic between distant areas.
Check opening days, entry tickets and timed-show schedules for museums and attractions in advance.
Visit temples early, dress respectfully and follow each site's footwear and entry guidance.
Consider a Hooghly ferry for a scenic river crossing, and keep valuables secure in crowded stations and markets.
Plan outdoor stops around monsoon showers and carry drinking water in warmer months.

image.alt: Howrah Bridge spanning the Hooghly River in Kolkata

name: Delhi
description: Discover India's capital through monumental avenues, Mughal-era landmarks and places of worship.

attractions.name: India Gate
attractions.description: Visit the war memorial on Kartavya Path and explore the surrounding central government district.

attractions.name: Red Fort
attractions.description: Explore the historic Mughal fort complex in Old Delhi; check current visitor access and opening hours.

attractions.name: Humayun's Tomb
attractions.description: Walk through the gardens and mausoleum complex, an important example of Mughal architecture.

attractions.name: Lotus Temple
attractions.description: See the Bahá’í House of Worship, known for its lotus-inspired form; follow visitor and prayer-area guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally more comfortable for sightseeing. Summers can be very hot, and monsoon showers are common from July to September.
travelTips: Group nearby attractions together and allow extra time for traffic between Old Delhi and south Delhi.
Use the Metro where convenient, and check current station access and service information.
Check each monument's current opening days, entry rules and ticket requirements before visiting.
The Lotus Temple is closed on Mondays; check its visitor guidance before planning a visit.
Carry water and sun protection, especially during warmer months.

name: Agra
description: Visit the Taj Mahal and explore the Mughal heritage of Agra, a separate city from Delhi.

areas: Taj Mahal on the Yamuna riverfront

attractions.name: Taj Mahal
attractions.description: Explore the 17th-century marble mausoleum and its gardens. The Taj Mahal is in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, not Delhi.

attractions.name: Agra Fort
attractions.description: Visit the historic Mughal fort overlooking the Yamuna River and the Taj Mahal.

attractions.name: Mehtab Bagh
attractions.description: Enjoy views of the Taj Mahal from this garden complex across the Yamuna River.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally more comfortable for sightseeing. Visit early in the day to avoid peak heat and crowds.
travelTips: The Taj Mahal is closed to visitors on Fridays; check official visitor information before travelling.
Check current ticketing, entry gates and security requirements in advance.
Allow time for queues and security checks, and follow restrictions on items inside the monument.
Agra is a separate city from Delhi; plan intercity transport and return times before making a day trip.

name: Amritsar
description: Experience Amritsar's Sikh heritage, moving history and vibrant old-city food culture.

areas: Golden Temple and the old city

attractions.name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib)
attractions.description: Visit Sikhism's holiest shrine. Cover your head, remove your shoes and follow the complex's visitor guidance.

attractions.name: Jallianwala Bagh
attractions.description: Reflect at the memorial garden commemorating the 1919 massacre; check current visiting hours.

attractions.name: Gobindgarh Fort
attractions.description: Explore the historic fort and its visitor experiences; check current opening times and ticket details.

attractions.name: Partition Museum
attractions.description: Learn about the 1947 Partition through archival material and personal accounts at the museum near Town Hall.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler for exploring the city. Summer afternoons can be very hot.
travelTips: Dress respectfully at the Golden Temple, cover your head and follow posted guidance around the sacred pool.
The Golden Temple welcomes visitors throughout the day; check current arrangements before your visit.
Check opening days and hours for Jallianwala Bagh, Gobindgarh Fort and the Partition Museum.
The old-city lanes can be busy; allow extra time for walking and local transport.

image.alt: Harmandir Sahib, the Golden Temple in Amritsar

name: Varanasi (Banaras)
description: Experience the sacred ghats, evening Ganga aarti and historic lanes of one of India's oldest living cities.

attractions.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
attractions.description: A central riverfront ghat known for its evening Ganga aarti; arrive early and follow crowd guidance.

attractions.name: Sarnath
attractions.description: Explore the Buddhist archaeological site and museum a short journey from the city.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler. Summers are very hot; monsoon rain can make the ghats and lanes slippery.

name: Goa
description: Discover Goa's beaches, Portuguese-era heritage, coastal villages and distinctive local cuisine.

attractions.name: Fontainhas
attractions.description: Walk through Panaji's colourful Latin Quarter and respect residents' privacy.

attractions.name: Old Goa
attractions.description: Visit historic churches and heritage sites; check current opening hours and dress guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is popular for beach weather. Monsoon season is rainy; some beach activities and services may change.

name: Tirupati
description: Visit Tirumala Venkateswara Temple and the forested hill region of the Eastern Ghats.

attractions.name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
attractions.description: A major pilgrimage temple; darshan access is managed through official booking and queue systems.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February is generally more comfortable. Festival dates can be exceptionally busy.

name: Tawang
description: Explore a high-altitude Himalayan town known for its monastery, mountain scenery and Monpa culture.

attractions.name: Tawang Monastery
attractions.description: Visit the historic hilltop monastery respectfully and follow local worship and photography guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: March to May and September to November are often preferred; winter snow and monsoon conditions can disrupt mountain roads.

name: Kaziranga
description: Experience the grasslands and wetlands of Kaziranga National Park, known for its wildlife and birdlife.

attractions.name: Kaziranga National Park
attractions.description: Explore only through authorised safari routes and operators; wildlife sightings are never guaranteed.

bestTimeToVisit: November to April is the usual visitor season. The park may close or restrict access during monsoon flooding; confirm current dates.

name: Chitrakote Falls
description: See the broad, horseshoe-shaped waterfall on the Indravati River near Jagdalpur.

attractions.name: Chitrakote viewpoint
attractions.description: View the falls from designated areas; water volume changes with season and rainfall.

bestTimeToVisit: July to October often brings stronger water flow; use extra caution during monsoon and check local access conditions.

name: Statue of Unity
description: Visit the Statue of Unity and Sardar Sarovar region near Kevadia.

attractions.name: Statue of Unity
attractions.description: Book official viewing and attraction tickets in advance and check operating days.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February is generally more comfortable. Summer afternoons can be very hot.

name: Kurukshetra
description: Explore pilgrimage sites, museums and places associated with the Mahabharata tradition.

attractions.name: Brahma Sarovar
attractions.description: Visit the large sacred water tank and follow local customs around the bathing areas.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler; major festival periods can be crowded.

name: Shimla
description: Walk the Himalayan hill town's Ridge and Mall Road and enjoy views from its historic railway route.

attractions.name: The Ridge and Mall Road
attractions.description: Explore the pedestrian town centre; steep streets and steps require comfortable footwear.

bestTimeToVisit: March to June is mild and popular; winter can bring snow and occasional road disruption.

name: Deoghar
description: Visit Baidyanath Dham and the temples and hills around this important pilgrimage town.

attractions.name: Baidyanath Dham
attractions.description: A major Shiva pilgrimage site; queues are especially long during Shravan and festival dates.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally more comfortable. Shravan is spiritually significant but very crowded.

name: Hampi
description: Explore the temples, boulder-strewn landscape and ruins of the Vijayanagara capital.

attractions.name: Vittala Temple complex
attractions.description: Visit the protected monument and follow ticket, access and conservation guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February is generally best for walking. Summer heat is intense and monsoon rain can make boulder paths slippery.

name: Munnar
description: Discover tea-covered hills, misty viewpoints and walking routes in the Western Ghats.

attractions.name: Eravikulam National Park
attractions.description: Check seasonal closures, entry rules and ticket availability before visiting.

bestTimeToVisit: September to March is often pleasant. Monsoon rain can be heavy and may affect roads and trekking.

name: Khajuraho
description: Admire the UNESCO-listed temple groups and the detailed stone architecture of Khajuraho.

attractions.name: Western Group of Temples
attractions.description: Explore the protected temple complex and respect conservation barriers and photography rules.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler for outdoor sightseeing. Summer afternoons can be very hot.

name: Ajanta Caves
description: Discover ancient Buddhist cave monasteries and paintings set in a horseshoe-shaped ravine.

attractions.name: Ajanta Caves
attractions.description: A protected monument; follow current ticketing, lighting and photography restrictions inside the caves.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is generally pleasant. Check weekly closure and transport arrangements before setting out.

name: Loktak Lake
description: See the floating phumdis, lake villages and wetlands of the largest freshwater lake in Northeast India.

attractions.name: Keibul Lamjao National Park
attractions.description: A protected wetland habitat; use authorised guides and follow conservation instructions.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally more comfortable. Check local access and travel advisories before visiting.

name: Shillong
description: Explore the pine-covered hill city, music scene, viewpoints and nearby waterfalls.

attractions.name: Elephant Falls
attractions.description: Follow marked paths and take care on wet steps, especially during the rainy season.

bestTimeToVisit: October to April is often drier. Monsoon months bring lush scenery but heavy rain and slippery paths.

name: Aizawl
description: Experience Mizoram's hilltop capital, local markets and Mizo culture.

attractions.name: Bara Bazar
attractions.description: Explore the central market respectfully and ask before photographing people or stalls.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler and drier; monsoon rain can affect steep roads.

name: Kohima
description: Explore Naga heritage, the Second World War cemetery and mountain scenery around Kohima.

attractions.name: Kohima War Cemetery
attractions.description: Visit this memorial respectfully and observe posted guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to May is generally preferred. The Hornbill Festival in December is popular and requires early booking.

name: Puri
description: Visit the Jagannath Temple, walk the Bay of Bengal shoreline and explore nearby heritage sites.

attractions.name: Puri Beach
attractions.description: Use designated bathing areas and follow lifeguard and sea-condition warnings.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February is generally more comfortable. The Rath Yatra period is significant and exceptionally crowded.

name: Jaipur
description: Discover the Pink City's forts, palaces, bazaars and traditional crafts.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Explore the hilltop fort using authorised access and follow conservation and animal-welfare guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally cooler for sightseeing. Summer afternoons are very hot.

name: Gangtok
description: Enjoy Himalayan viewpoints, monasteries and the lively markets of Sikkim's capital.

attractions.name: MG Marg
attractions.description: A pedestrian town centre; follow local public-space rules and keep the area litter-free.

bestTimeToVisit: March to May and October to mid-December often offer clearer views. Monsoon rain can cause landslides and road delays.

name: Madurai
description: Visit the Meenakshi Amman Temple and experience Madurai's historic markets and Tamil food culture.

attractions.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
attractions.description: A major active temple; follow current footwear, dress, security and photography rules.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is generally cooler. Summer heat can be intense; festival dates are busy.

name: Hyderabad
description: Explore the Charminar, historic bazaars, museums and the city's celebrated Deccani food.

attractions.name: Charminar
attractions.description: Visit the historic landmark and nearby market; expect dense traffic and crowds around the old city.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is generally more comfortable. Summers are hot and monsoon rain can slow traffic.

name: Agartala
description: Discover Tripura's royal history, local markets and cultural landmarks in Agartala.

attractions.name: Ujjayanta Palace
attractions.description: The former royal palace now houses a museum; check current gallery hours and photography guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally pleasant. Monsoon rain can be heavy from June to September.

name: Rishikesh
description: Experience Ganga-side ashrams, suspension bridges, yoga centres and outdoor activities.

attractions.name: Triveni Ghat
attractions.description: Attend the riverside aarti respectfully and follow safety signs near the water.

bestTimeToVisit: October to April is generally comfortable. Avoid entering the river during strong currents or official warnings.

name: Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)
description: Explore the Andaman Islands' gateway city, coastal viewpoints and the Cellular Jail memorial.

attractions.name: Cellular Jail
attractions.description: Visit the national memorial and check current museum and sound-and-light show schedules.

bestTimeToVisit: November to April is generally drier. Monsoon seas can disrupt ferries and island connections.

name: Chandigarh
description: Explore the planned city's modernist architecture, gardens and the distinctive Rock Garden.

attractions.name: Rock Garden
attractions.description: Explore the sculptural garden and follow posted rules on pathways and exhibits.

bestTimeToVisit: October to March is generally comfortable. Summer temperatures can be very high.

name: Diu
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Visit Diu Fort, coastal promenades and beaches on this relaxed Arabian Sea island.

location.state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

attractions.name: Diu Fort
attractions.description: Explore the coastal fort carefully; stay behind barriers and keep clear of exposed edges.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is generally pleasant. Avoid swimming when sea conditions or lifeguards advise against it.

name: Srinagar
description: Experience Dal Lake, Mughal gardens, houseboats and the mountain landscape around Kashmir's summer capital.

attractions.name: Dal Lake
attractions.description: Use registered boat operators and agree on route and price before setting out.

bestTimeToVisit: April to October is popular for gardens and lake visits; winter is cold and can bring snow or travel disruption.

name: Leh
description: Explore Ladakh's high-altitude monasteries, mountain scenery and markets around Leh.

attractions.name: Leh Palace
attractions.description: Visit the hilltop heritage site at a gentle pace and allow time to acclimatise to altitude.

bestTimeToVisit: May to September is the main road-trip season. Winter is severe; high passes and routes may close.

name: Kavaratti
description: Discover lagoon scenery, coral islands and local island life in Lakshadweep's capital.

attractions.name: Kavaratti lagoon
attractions.description: Use authorised operators for water activities and follow coral and marine-life protection guidance.

bestTimeToVisit: October to May is generally more suitable for travel. Monsoon weather can interrupt boat and flight connections.

name: Puducherry
description: Walk the heritage streets, seafront promenade and cafes of this coastal Union Territory.

attractions.name: White Town and Promenade
attractions.description: Explore the heritage streets on foot and follow local signs near the seafront.

bestTimeToVisit: November to February is generally cooler. The northeast monsoon can bring heavy rain from October to December.
